page.overview:
Who is Jing Lee?

3382 Jing Lee the Wanderer 4224631 Jing Lee Key Chain KC36 Jing Lee Key Chain

Jing Lee, also called the Wanderer, is an Adventurers Orient Expedition minifigure introduced in 2003.

Jing Lee has a black ponytail. Her face has short eyebrows, ovular eyes, and pale lips. She wears a green oriental shirt with black Chinese symbols (禾中, Hé Zhōng) and yellow embroidery, and red pants.

Jing Lee is a martial artist taught by her father. After Emperor Chang Wu had her father short, she became a freedom fighter opposing the false emperor's rule. In all versions of the story, Jing Lee helps the heroic adventurers find the Dragon Fortress and recover the Golden Dragon, although details differ between various media.
